newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - COSCO Pacific rated reduce.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - COSCO Pacific rated reduce.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it initiated coverage of container leasing group COSCO Pacific Ltd with an intermediate-term recommendation of reduce, adding the shares could trade 10-15 percent lower in the intermediate term.
COSCO Pacific was overvalued at the present share price of HK$8.75, the U.S. securities house said in a recent report.
The shares stood at HK$8.95 at Tuesday midday, up HK$0.05.

"While the company will likely continue to enjoy vigorous support from its parent and majority shareholder, the valuation premium that we believe this support engenders has limits that have been reached in the intermediate term," Merrill Lynch said.
COSCO Pacific is a subsidiary of state-owned China Ocean Shipping Company (COSCO).
Merrill said COSCO Pacific was likely to underperform given its forecast given its 12-month objective for the Hang Seng Index at 15,400, up 14 percent from its current level.

It estimated the fair value of COSCO Pacific's shares at HK$5.23 at most, implied by either discounted cash flow or break-up value approaches. Merrill said the present share price suggested a valuation of the company at over US$2.1 billion, adding it estimated the company's maximum value at US$1.75 billion, or about HK$7 per share. -- HK Newsroom (852)2843-6441
